verdict: Pass for selection-idle asset integration; generated art remains pending user design review.

checks.frameHashes: All 32 independently rehashed and match manifest.
checks.outputGeometry: All 32 frames are 1024x896 transparent PNG; independent alpha scan found no opaque pixels within 2px of output edges.
checks.sourceCells: Manifest contains zero source-cell edge findings; visual contact and state strips show complete sword silhouettes.
checks.identity: Rune shoulders, teal cape, round helmet ear disk, swept crest, vented silver helmet, low cyan greatsword and right-facing hero orientation preserved.
checks.idle: Four distinct authored poses. Adjacent and last-to-first pose inspection shows restrained breathing and cape/weapon differences. Common source roots map within 0.5px of 448,816; no large lateral travel.
checks.statesSemantics: Attack anticipates overhead and slashes with recovery. Cast extends offhand then lowers it. Hit recoils and recovers. Wounded idle stoops; death collapses to a terminal prone pose.
checks.readability: Reviewed contact plus all six large state strips on light/dark backgrounds and idle96px strip. Identity and blade remain legible at selection scale.
checks.selectionExport: Four320px cells with single shared scale/translation; no frame-by-frame size fitting.

findings.description: Canvas documented as896x896 but output and manifest are1024x896. Requested builder correction.

limitations: Review used actual exported frame imagery and packer/preview code, not browser playback. Parent owns browser sizing and centering verification.
Simple keyframe animation intentionally has stepped transitions. This is not an assertion of interpolated skeletal motion.
Non-idle states are preview/package assets; no combat integration validated.
Technical review does not approve new artwork in the gallery ledger.
